## histograms
```{r}
#histogram 
hist(df$Day)
hist(df$Coke2Liter)
hist(df$Advil30CntGel)
hist(df$BountyPaperTowel2pk)
hist(df$IvorySoap6pk)
```
## run chart
```{r}
# line plot of data
plot(df$Day,type="b")
abline(h=mean(df$Day))
plot(df$Coke2Liter,type="b")
plot(df$Advil30CntGel,type="b")
plot(df$BountyPaperTowel2pk,type="b")
plot(df$IvorySoap6pk,type="b")
```
## scatter plots
```{r}
# scatter plots
plot(df$Day, df$Coke2Liter)
plot(df$Day, df$Advil30CntGel)
plot(df$Day, df$BountyPaperTowel2pk)
plot(df$Day, df$IvorySoap6pk)
plot(df$Coke2Liter, df$Advil30CntGel)
plot(df$Coke2Liter, df$BountyPaperTowel2pk)
plot(df$Coke2Liter, df$IvorySoap6pk)
plot(df$Advil30CntGel, df$BountyPaperTowel2pk)
plot(df$Advil30CntGel, df$IvorySoap6pk)
plot(df$BountyPaperTowel2pk, df$IvorySoap6pk)
```
